text: This principle simplifies the development of isomorphic applications, because the state on the server can be serialized and injected into the client without doing anything else. A single-source-of-truth state tree also simplifies debugging and monitoring of the application; it also lets you persist application data locally during development, thereby accelerating the development cycle. In addition, some features that were previously difficult to implement, such as "undo/redo", become very easy to implement with Redux under the single source of truth principle.
